paper_id: Dong et al. - 2009 - WormCircle Connectivity-Based Wormhole Detection in Wireless Ad Hoc and Sensor Networks
title: WormCircle: Connectivity-Based Wormhole Detection in Wireless Ad Hoc and Sensor Networks
motivation: 现有检测方法依赖专用硬件或强假设,在资源受限的传感器网络中不适用
problem_framing: 将蠕虫洞检测重新定义为拓扑异常检测,基于连通性信息识别蠕虫洞特征圆
key_insight: 蠕虫洞会改变网络等值线的几何特性:其周长2π(R-r)显著小于正常值2πR
method_signature: 基于最短路径树追踪等值线圆,通过周长与层级比值检测蠕虫洞圆
evaluation_criteria: 检测成功率(α类>β类),节点密度影响,部署随机性影响
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: γ类蠕虫洞(两端在边界)与普通桥接无法区分;根节点选择不当时蠕虫洞圆消失
evidence_for_taste: WormCircle potentially can detect some wormholes that cannot be detected by approaches based on Euclidean distance mismatch
a γ-class wormhole and a common bridge are indistinguishable from the local neighborhood
most existing solutions of wormhole detection require specialized hardware devices or making strong assumptions
Wormhole attack can be launched successfully without compromising any legitimate node or breaking cryptographic mechanisms
thinking_moves: 将物理波动现象类比到网络拓扑,利用波前圆的周长异常检测蠕虫洞
通过连通性验证局部连续性,用跳数近似几何距离,避免硬件依赖
从连续域证明正确性,再扩展到离散网络实现
承认方法局限:γ类蠕虫洞不可检测,根选择影响检测率
迭代改进:从全局最短路径树到纯局部连通性信息
